title: After the Japanese Derby: Clutching at Dreams

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The curtain falls on Ines Fujin's Japanese Derby experience. Her dream of becoming the Derby champion is over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even amid the raucous support for the new Derby champion, there are those in the audience who cheer for Ines Fujin, who ran as she wanted to, and gave the race all she had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summoning the last of her strength, Ines Fujin gives the crowd a huge wave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The moment she returns to the waiting room, however, Ines Fujin collapses to the floor…
